notes.title: Free Update -- Experimental Weapons
notes.notes:
[h3]Experimental Weapons[/h3]
Another military company now provide its new developed experimental for all 3 factions. Players can pick one of them at the start of the game, and build them in Tier 3 technology.

1. Asgard Tank
Twin cannon heavy tank, with machinegun and rocket launcher.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35452173/3cb4ae67f7f4cebba87007259db72d1554fe2d78.png[/img]

2. Quake Gunship
Powerful air gunship, with auto cannon and ground tagret missile launcher.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35452173/f911900cb308f7ff547b5088335b34e8c1ec78cb.png[/img]

3. Muspelheim Gunship
Powerful air gunship, with auto cannon and Napalm launcher
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35452173/89d0e7d5ef01872e4764aee373cc7f4bc7f40526.png[/img]

[h3]4 new units for Steel Alliance and Legion[/h3]
Steel Alliance:
1. Conreve MLRS
2. Longbow Missile Launcher

Legion:

notes.title: Armor Clash 3 version 2.30: Super Weapon
notes.notes:
[b]New Units:[/b]
1. Hercules Class drone carrier: 
A powerful aircraft carrier loading 12 attack drones.
2. AC-130 gunship:
Player controllable air gunship.
3. Tu-95 heavy bomber:
Make massive bombardment to ground targets.
4. T-50 fighter:
Multi-purpose air unit, can make high damage to both air and ground targets.
5. Flak fire support vehicle:
Fire autocannon to air and ground targets at a long range.

[b]Balance:[/b]
1. Legion default tech time reduced from 11 minutes to 10 minutes.
2. Resource income from resource center  25%.
3. Resource income from captured points  20%.

[b]Others:[/b]
1. Add feedback force effect to MGS and other light combat vehicles.

notes.title: Version 2.0: Navy, new maps, Linux support and Halloween Pumpkin
notes.notes:
[b]Version 2.0 Announcement Trailer[/b]
[previewyoutube=FNIrS_noEHQ;full][/previewyoutube]

For each faction, there are 3 navy units, from gunboat to aircraft carrier. Players can make them from the new shipyard building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35452173/0dc72a397b4ebc4d2c38d7d835d105e23109db1c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35452173/e284e11fc8c6786a85647ed041f1015fed92a619.jpg[/img]

Map modes are also changed from "1v1", "2v2", "Challenge" to "Air/Land Battle", "Air/Land/Sea Battle", "Challenge". In the "Air/Land/Sea Battle" mode, the map will contain large waters zones for navy battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35452173/df3d16cdbfab0fc39ca7752710adc456f55c122e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35452173/3f7f859adddb2145fae07c45a99c4ada07fefe6e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35452173/cac74612179594ac7a217c2d1ff44b94093af4db.jpg[/img]

Armor Clash 3 will be still in update, there will be new units and maps in the future for free, I will still keep working hard on this game, to give thanks to players who supported this game.

notes.title: Update 1.03: Hotkey to select all units.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35452173/955046b4ac9176d18acc79ebf100a1773575b14f.png[/img]

1. Add 3 hotkey shortcast on the top of the radar. "Q" to select all combat unit except airplanes. "W" to switch to construct vehicle, and "E" to select all airplanes.


2. Resources gathered from resource center each time increased from 70 to 100, resource gather from flag point each time increased from 35 to 40.


3. Mi-24 Hind team color error fixed.


4. Fixed some bumped zone in Railway and other maps to avoid units stuck there.


5. Fixed a bug that player 3 and player 4 do not gain experience when destroyed enemy units.


6. Artillery unit now can attack in the most possible fire range in attack move order.
